source.title: A misalignment of AI in mathematics
source.author: meredydd

title.zh: AI数学错位声明引发讨论

excerpt.zh: AI数学错位声明警示，若把大模型解题能力当作竞赛基准，数学研究可能失去对理解、归因和学生培养的重视。
excerpt.en: AI in mathematics faces a warning: treating LLM problem-solving as a benchmark may weaken understanding, attribution, and training.

text.zh: AI数学错位声明说了什么
text.en: What the AI in Mathematics Warning Says

text.zh: AI数学成为最新争议中心。一个题为“A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics”的声明在 mathandai.org 发布，并在 Hacker News 获得586分和648条评论；它不是否认LLM的进步，而是警告把解题当作AI竞赛指标，可能偏离数学研究的核心目标。
text.en: AI in mathematics has become a fresh point of debate. A declaration titled “A Severe Misalignment of AI in Mathematics” appeared on mathandai.org and drew 586 points and 648 comments on Hacker News; it does not deny progress in LLMs, but warns that turning problem solving into an AI competition metric may pull mathematics away from its central purpose.

text.zh: 声明称，过去数月LLM数学能力显著提升，已经能解决许多领域的重大未解问题。作者同时强调，数学的目的不是堆积真伪命题，而是在共同审阅、讲座、讨论和教材化过程中沉淀概念理解。
text.en: The declaration says that LLM mathematical ability has improved sharply in recent months, to the point of solving major open problems in many areas. At the same time, its authors stress that mathematics is not just the accumulation of true-or-false statements, but a slow process of review, talks, discussion, simplification, and eventual teaching.

text.zh: Math and AI声明的关键事实
text.en: Key Facts in the Math and AI Declaration

text.zh: 这份“Math and AI”声明列出多名支持者，其中包括多位菲尔兹奖得主，如Artur Avila、Manjul Bhargava、Terence Tao和Maryna Viazovska。这样的署名阵容说明，担忧来自数学共同体内部，而不只是普通的技术保守反应。
text.en: The “Math and AI” declaration lists many endorsers, including Fields Medalists such as Artur Avila, Manjul Bhargava, Terence Tao, and Maryna Viazovska. That roster suggests the concern is coming from within the mathematical community, not merely from a general resistance to new technology.

text.zh: 它的核心主张是目标错位：AI公司需要可展示的基准和突破，数学共同体需要可追溯的方法、可靠归因和能被学生继续学习的思想链条。两者都重视结果，但评估结果的时间尺度不同。
text.en: Its central claim is misalignment of goals: AI companies need visible benchmarks and breakthroughs, while the mathematical community needs traceable methods, reliable attribution, and chains of ideas that students can continue to learn from. Both care about results, but they judge those results on very different timelines.

text.zh: 为什么AI基准会扭曲研究
text.en: Why AI Benchmarks Could Distort Research

text.zh: 技术上，LLM若能快速产出证明或判断，会把“解决问题”从长期训练的一环变成即时产物。声明担心，匆忙发布会压缩写作、引用、简化和同行吸收的时间，使新方法难以进入数学典范。
text.en: Technically, if LLMs can rapidly produce proofs or judgments, “solving a problem” can shift from being one stage in long training into an immediate output. The declaration worries that rushed announcements compress the time needed for writing, citation, simplification, and community absorption, making it harder for new methods to enter the mathematical canon.

text.zh: 这种担忧也涉及归因。数学证明常建立在讲座、私人讨论和前人成果之上；如果AI系统借助既有语料直接输出结果，哪些想法属于模型、训练资料或具体研究者，可能难以清晰界定。
text.en: The concern also reaches attribution. Mathematical proofs often build on lectures, private conversations, and previous work; if an AI system outputs results from a vast background of existing material, it may become difficult to separate what belongs to the model, the training corpus, or specific researchers.

text.zh: 影响、限制与结论
text.en: Implications, Limits, and Conclusion

text.zh: 实践上，声明并未把AI描述成只能破坏数学。它承认AI可能增强和加速真正的学习与理解；关键在于人类如何设定激励、发布规范和社区接纳流程，而不是只追逐抢先证明。
text.en: In practical terms, the declaration does not portray AI as only destructive to mathematics. It acknowledges that AI could enhance and accelerate genuine study and understanding; the crucial issue is how humans set incentives, publication norms, and community processes, rather than simply rewarding the fastest proof.

text.zh: 仍有开放问题：声明没有给出具体治理方案，也没有说明如何衡量AI辅助证明的贡献比例。未来更现实的路径，可能是把AI定位为研究助手，同时保护学生训练、引用秩序和慢速共识。
text.en: Open questions remain: the declaration does not offer a detailed governance scheme, nor does it explain how to measure the contribution of AI-assisted proofs. A more realistic path may be to treat AI as a research assistant while protecting student training, citation order, and slow-form consensus.

text.zh: 结论是，AI数学的风险不在于机器会算得太快本身，而在于速度和声量可能遮蔽数学为何存在。若公司、研究者和社会能把理解置于基准之上，AI才更可能成为学科的放大器。
text.en: The conclusion is that the risk in AI mathematics is not speed itself, but the possibility that speed and publicity obscure why mathematics exists. If companies, researchers, and society place understanding above benchmarks, AI is more likely to become an amplifier of the field.
